deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'if [ "${APP_ROLE:-web}" = "worker" ] || [ "${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME:-}" = "heroic-wisdom" ]; then exec celery -A subzero_core worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=1; else python -u manage.py migrate --noinput && python -u manage.py ensure_staff_admin && exec daphne -b 0.0.0.0 -p $PORT subzero_core.asgi:application; fi'
